results.question: Hver var stærsti birgir Veðurstofunnar árið 2025 og hvað fékk hann mikið greitt?
results.reference_sql: SELECT v.name, SUM(l.amount) AS s FROM invoice_line l JOIN invoice i ON i.id = l.invoice_id JOIN buyer b ON b.id = i.buyer_id JOIN vendor v ON v.id = i.vendor_id WHERE b.name = 'Veðurstofa Íslands' GROUP BY v.id ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 1
results.answer: Stærsti birgir Veðurstofu Íslands árið 2025 var **Origo ehf.**, og hann fékk greitt **186.442.867 kr.**
queries:
SELECT v.name AS vendor, SUM(l.amount) AS total_isk
FROM invoice i
JOIN invoice_line l ON l.invoice_id = i.id
JOIN buyer b ON b.id = i.buyer_id
JOIN vendor v ON v.id = i.vendor_id
WHERE b.name = 'Veðurstofa Íslands'
  AND i.payment_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY v.id, v.name
ORDER BY total_isk DESC, vendor ASC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: Hvaða birgir fékk mest greitt frá ríkinu á árinu 2025, og hversu mikið?
results.reference_sql: SELECT v.name, SUM(l.amount) AS s FROM invoice_line l JOIN invoice i ON i.id = l.invoice_id JOIN vendor v ON v.id = i.vendor_id GROUP BY v.id ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 1
results.answer: Mest greiddi birgirinn árið 2025 var **Distica hf.** með **13.213.513.954 kr.**
queries:
SELECT v.name AS vendor, SUM(l.amount) AS total_isk
FROM invoice_line l
JOIN invoice i ON i.id = l.invoice_id
JOIN vendor v ON v.id = i.vendor_id
WHERE i.payment_date >= '2025-01-01' AND i.payment_date < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY v.id
ORDER BY total_isk DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: Hvað greiddi Háskóli Íslands mikið í húsaleigu árið 2025?
results.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(l.amount) FROM invoice_line l JOIN invoice i ON i.id = l.invoice_id JOIN buyer b ON b.id = i.buyer_id JOIN cost_type t ON t.id = l.cost_type_id WHERE b.name = 'Háskóli Íslands' AND t.name = 'Húsaleiga'
results.answer: Háskóli Íslands greiddi 3.962.062.989 kr. í húsaleigu árið 2025.
queries:
SELECT SUM(l.amount) AS total_isk
FROM line_flat l
WHERE l.buyer = 'Háskóli Íslands'
  AND l.cost_type = 'Húsaleiga'
  AND l.payment_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31';

results.question: Frá hversu mörgum stofnunum fékk Advania greitt árið 2025?
results.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.buyer_id) FROM invoice i JOIN vendor v ON v.id = i.vendor_id WHERE v.name = 'Advania Ísland ehf.'
results.answer: Advania Ísland ehf. fékk greitt frá 148 stofnunum árið 2025.
queries:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.name) AS institution_count
FROM invoice i
JOIN buyer b ON b.id = i.buyer_id
JOIN vendor v ON v.id = i.vendor_id
WHERE i.payment_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  AND v.name = 'Advania Ísland ehf.';

results.question: Hvaða stofnanir greiddu enga reikninga í desember 2025?
results.reference_sql: SELECT b.name FROM buyer b LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT buyer_id FROM invoice WHERE payment_date >= '2025-12-01') d ON d.buyer_id = b.id WHERE d.buyer_id IS NULL
results.answer:
Engar reikningsgreiðslur í desember 2025 voru skráðar fyrir þessar stofnanir:

- Háskólinn á Bifröst
- Menningar- og viðskiptaráðuneyti, aðalskrifstofa
- Orkustofnun
- Ríkiskaup
- Umhverfisstofnun
- Vatnajökulsþjóðgarður

Vinsamlegast athugið að þetta miðast við birtar greiðslur í gagnagrunninum.
queries:
WITH buyers AS (
  SELECT id, name FROM buyer
), dec_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT buyer_id
  FROM invoice
  WHERE payment_date >= '2025-12-01' AND payment_date < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT b.name
FROM buyers b
LEFT JOIN dec_buyers d ON d.buyer_id = b.id
WHERE d.buyer_id IS NULL
ORDER BY b.name;

results.question: Hvað greiddi Landspítalinn mikið í október 2025?
results.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(l.amount) FROM invoice_line l JOIN invoice i ON i.id = l.invoice_id JOIN buyer b ON b.id = i.buyer_id WHERE b.name = 'Landspítali' AND substr(i.payment_date, 1, 7) = '2025-10'
queries:
SELECT SUM(l.amount) AS total_isk
FROM invoice_line l
JOIN invoice i ON i.id = l.invoice_id
JOIN buyer b ON b.id = i.buyer_id
WHERE b.name = 'Landspítali'
  AND i.payment_date >= '2025-10-01'
  AND i.payment_date < '2025-11-01';

results.question: Hversu margir reikningar voru greiddir á fleiri en einum degi, það er sami kaupandi, birgir og reikningsnúmer með fleiri en eina greiðsludagsetningu?
results.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM invoice GROUP BY buyer_id, vendor_id, invoice_number HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT payment_date) > 1)
results.answer: 902 reikningar voru greiddir á fleiri en einum degi.
queries:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_groups_with_multiple_payment_dates
FROM (
  SELECT buyer_id, vendor_id, invoice_number
  FROM invoice
  GROUP BY buyer_id, vendor_id, invoice_number
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT payment_date) > 1
) t;
